title: Venue
description: A venue description for the indoor AR wayfinding app: metadata, floors, a route graph of nodes and edges, points of interest, physical anchors, and positioning-provider configuration. Authored by the venue operator. All coordinates are venue-local metres in a right-handed frame with x and y in the floor plane and z up; the origin and the direction of +y are fixed by the operator and shared by every floor. The document must not contain GPS coordinates anywhere.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema the document follows. Only 1 is currently defined.

id.description: Stable identifier for the venue, unique per operator. Encoded into QR anchors, so it should never change once markers are printed.

name.description: Human-readable venue name shown in the app.

description.description: Optional longer description of the venue.

frame.description: Relates the venue's coordinate frame to the physical world without exposing its location.

headingOffsetDeg.description: Degrees, clockwise, from the device compass's north to the venue's +y axis. Lets dead reckoning turn compass headings into venue headings. Default 0.

floors.description: The venue's floors. At least one. Nodes and anchors reference floors by `index`.

nodes.description: Vertices of the route graph: every place a route can pass through or end at. At least one.

edges.description: Walkable connections between nodes. An edge may be excluded from a route by accessibility, access level or opening hours (see src/core/router.js).

pois.description: Points of interest a user can search for and navigate to. Each is attached to a node, which is where routing delivers the user.

anchors.description: Physical markers (printed QR codes) with a known standing position and facing, used by the QR positioning provider.

runtimeConfigUrl.description: URL of the venue's runtime config (see src/venues/runtime-config.js): a small JSON file the operator can edit at any time to close edges or hide points of interest without redeploying. Fetched at startup and polled. Relative URLs resolve against the venue JSON's URL.

languages.description: Community languages the venue adds or overrides, keyed by BCP 47 language code (e.g. "sm", "to", "mi"). Each provides a display name and a partial or complete set of UI strings keyed as in src/ui/strings/en.js; keys not translated fall back to English. Lets a venue offer its own languages without a code change.

name.description: The language's name, in that language, shown in the language menu.

strings.description: UI string overrides keyed by string id. Placeholders such as {name} must be kept.

providers.description: Configuration for positioning providers. Keys other than `order` are per-provider blocks, keyed by provider name; unknown providers are permitted so that new ones can be configured without a schema change.

order.description: Explicit fallback order of providers to try, first to last. When omitted the app derives it: `immersal` if configured, then `qr` if the venue has anchors, then `mock` if the app allows it.

qr.description: QR provider options. The provider needs nothing beyond `anchors`; this block is reserved for future options.

mock.description: Mock provider options (development only). Passed through to MockProvider.

slug.description: An identifier: letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`, starting with a letter or digit.

openingWindow.description: A window during which something is open. `close` earlier than `open` means the window spans midnight (e.g. 18:00–02:00).

days.description: Days of the week the window applies to, 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday (as `Date.prototype.getDay()`). Omit for every day.

hours.description: Opening windows. Omit when always open. Something with an empty list is never open.

access.description: Who may use this: `public` (anyone) or `staff` (staff only). Default `public`.

index.description: Integer floor index used by nodes, anchors and poses; e.g. 0 = ground, -1 = basement, 1 = first. Unique within the venue.

id.description: Stable identifier for the floor. Unique within the venue.

elevation.description: Height of the floor's walking surface above the venue origin, in metres. Lets a provider that reports height choose the floor. Optional.

plan.description: The floor-plan image this floor was digitised from, and how its pixels map to venue metres. Written by scripts/build-venue.mjs; lets a 2-D map view draw the plan under the route. Optional.

image.description: File name or URL of the plan image, relative to the venue JSON.

metresPerPixel.description: Scale of the plan: venue metres per image pixel.

originPx.description: Image pixel (origin top-left, y down) that corresponds to venue (0, 0). Venue +y points up the image.

x.description: Pixel column of the venue origin.

y.description: Pixel row of the venue origin.

id.description: Unique node id, referenced by edges, POIs and routes.

z.description: Height in metres above the venue origin. Defaults to 0; usually the floor's `elevation`.

floor.description: Index of the floor this node is on. Must match a `floors[].index`.

name.description: Optional label for the node (e.g. "Lift lobby"), for operator tooling and debugging.

from.description: Id of the node at one end.

to.description: Id of the node at the other end. Must differ from `from`.

type.description: Kind of connection. Sets the accessibility defaults: `stairs` and `escalator` are not step-free; everything else is. Default `walk`.

distance.description: Walking length of the edge in metres. Defaults to the straight-line distance between its nodes. If given it must not be less than the straight-line distance, or route search is no longer guaranteed optimal.

oneWay.description: True if the edge may only be traversed from `from` to `to` (e.g. a one-way gate or an escalator). Default false.

stepFree.description: True if the edge can be used without climbing or descending steps. Defaults from `type`: false for `stairs` and `escalator`, true otherwise. Set explicitly to override (e.g. a stair lift).

wheelchair.description: True if a wheelchair user can use the edge. Defaults to `stepFree`. Set false on step-free edges that are still unusable (narrow door, steep ramp). Cannot be true on a non-step-free edge.

staffOnly.description: True if only staff may use the edge (staff door, back corridor). Visitors' routes never use it. Default false.

floorChange.description: True if the edge connects different floors (stairs, lift, escalator, ramp between levels). Defaults to whether its two nodes are on different floors; if given it must agree with them.

hours.description: When the edge is usable, e.g. a corridor locked at night. Omit when always open.

closed.description: True while the edge is closed (maintenance, incident). Routing never uses a closed edge. Normally set by the runtime config rather than authored here.

closedReason.description: Why the edge is closed, shown to users. Optional.

name.description: Optional label for the edge, for operator tooling.

id.description: Unique POI id. Stable; used in links and analytics.

name.description: Display name. Need not be unique (e.g. "Toilets" on every floor).

aliases.description: Other names users might search for ("Help desk", "Info", "WC"). Matched case- and whitespace-insensitively.

floor.description: Index of the floor the POI is on. Optional; defaults to its node's floor, and if given must match it.

node.description: Id of the route node routing delivers the user to for this POI.

category.description: Free-text category for filtering and icons, e.g. "retail", "food", "facility", "service", "exit".

access.description: `public` (default) or `staff`. Staff-only POIs are hidden from visitors.

description.description: Optional longer description shown on the POI's detail view.

hours.description: The POI's opening hours, for display and "closed now" hints. Omit when always open.

hidden.description: True while the POI should not be offered (temporarily closed, relocated). Normally set by the runtime config.

id.description: Unique anchor id, encoded into the printed QR code together with the venue id.

x.description: Metres along +x of where the user STANDS when scanning.

y.description: Metres along +y of where the user stands when scanning.

z.description: Height in metres of the standing position. Default 0.

floor.description: Index of the floor the anchor is on. Must match a `floors[].index`.

heading.description: Direction the user faces when scanning, in degrees clockwise from venue +y, in [0, 360). Default 0.

immersalConfig.description: Immersal VPS provider configuration. The API key is NOT here; it comes from the IMMERSAL_API_KEY environment variable.

mapId.description: Id of the Immersal map covering the venue, from the Immersal Mapper app.

origin.description: Venue-local coordinates of the Immersal map's origin, in metres.

x.description: Venue x of the map origin, metres.

y.description: Venue y of the map origin, metres.

z.description: Venue z (height) of the map origin, metres.

rotationDeg.description: Yaw, in degrees counter-clockwise about venue +z, that turns the map's horizontal axes onto the venue's. Default 0.

floor.description: Fixed floor index for every pose from this map. Omit to derive the floor from `floors[].elevation`.
